title: window_thresholds/<time>/meta.json
description: Where the thresholds of window models came from.

scores.description: The window scores of the calibration set the thresholds were taken from.

models.description: The directory the models came from.

calibration_set.description: The calibration set the rows came from, as the scores record it.

log_split.description: The log split, as the scores record it.

grid.description: The grid, as the scores record it.

min_speed.description: The speed a row had to exceed to be in a window.

windows.description: How many windows each threshold was taken from, in the order of `thresholds.json`.
